svg.title: Amenorrhea decision chart: beta-hCG first, then is there a uterus (no: testosterone and karyotype split Mullerian agenesis from androgen insensitivity), then prolactin and TSH, then FSH (high: karyotype, Turner or primary ovarian insufficiency; low: hypothalamus or pituitary, MRI; normal: the progesterone withdrawal test splits anovulation from an outflow block); each column gives clues, investigations and treatment
